integrity: The proof uses direct rational functional calculus and algebraic sign analysis. A standalone SymPy checker reproduces critical identities; finite computations do not replace quantified proof.
limitations: The exact positivity interval applies to the specified pure-birth generator, not to arbitrary three-state or nonlinear problems. No stagewise positivity is asserted. Specialized unindexed literature may contain equivalent results.
title: A sharp three-state positivity window for fifth-order Radau IIA
